s0201.literal: Director of Ceremonies Toqquz was dispatched to present one bronze cup and two dou to the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0201.idiomatic: Director of Ceremonies Toqquz was sent to present one bronze cup and two dou vessels to the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0202.literal: Oljei, wanhu commandant of forty thousand households, was made associate administrator.
s0202.idiomatic: Oljei, wanhu commandant of forty thousand households, was made associate administrator.

s0203.literal: In the ninth month, on the renchen new moon, the National Preceptor Yilianzhen was ordered to perform Buddhist rites at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0203.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the renchen new moon, National Preceptor Yilianzhen was ordered to perform Buddhist rites at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0204.literal: On jihai day offerings were made at the Imperial Ancestral Temple; in addition to the regular fare, wild boar, deer, sheep, and grape wine were added.
s0204.idiomatic: On jihai day offerings were made at the Imperial Ancestral Temple; beyond the regular fare, wild boar, deer, sheep, and grape wine were added.

s0205.literal: On gengzi day Yao Shu and Wang Pan were ordered to select Song students from the three academies who had real learning to remain at the capital; the rest were permitted to return home.
s0205.idiomatic: On gengzi day Yao Shu and Wang Pan were ordered to select Song students from the three academies who had genuine learning to remain at the capital; the rest were free to return home.

s0206.literal: On xinchou day four thousand Luzhou garrison-farming troops were dispatched to transport grain to Chongqing.
s0206.idiomatic: On xinchou day four thousand Luzhou garrison-farming troops were sent to transport grain to Chongqing.

s0207.literal: On guimao day a general amnesty was proclaimed for the pacification of Song.
s0207.idiomatic: On guimao day a general amnesty was proclaimed for the pacification of Song.

s0208.literal: On yisi day King Wang Chŏm of Goryeo reported the merits of councilor and associate privy counselor Kim Panggyŏng, who was granted a tiger tally.
s0208.idiomatic: On yisi day King Wang Chŏm of Goryeo reported the merits of councilor and associate privy counselor Kim Panggyŏng, who received a tiger tally.

s0209.literal: On bingwu day an edict ordered Changde Prefecture to submit wrapped reeds as annual tribute.
s0209.idiomatic: On bingwu day an edict ordered Changde Prefecture to submit wrapped reeds as annual tribute.

s0210.literal: On dingwei day the Sichuan branch privy council was instructed to send a proclamation to Chongqing calling for submission.
s0210.idiomatic: On dingwei day the Sichuan branch privy council was instructed to send a proclamation to Chongqing calling for submission.

s0211.literal: The responsible offices were ordered to demolish fortifications along the Huai.
s0211.idiomatic: The responsible offices were ordered to demolish fortifications along the Huai.

s0212.literal: On xinhai day Venus transited the Southern Dipper.
s0212.idiomatic: On xinhai day Venus transited the Southern Dipper.

s0213.literal: On jiayin day Venus entered the Southern Dipper.
s0213.idiomatic: On jiayin day Venus entered the Southern Dipper.

s0214.literal: On yimao day the Tibetan Heda city was made Ningyuan Prefecture.
s0214.idiomatic: On yimao day the Tibetan Heda city was made Ningyuan Prefecture.

s0215.literal: On xinyou day Song clansman Zhao Yupiao, instructor at E Prefecture, was summoned to court.
s0215.idiomatic: On xinyou day Song clansman Zhao Yupiao, instructor at E Prefecture, was summoned to court.

s0216.literal: A precept ordination assembly was held at the capital.
s0216.idiomatic: A precept ordination assembly was held at the capital.

s0217.literal: Aju came to court for audience.
s0217.idiomatic: Aju came to court for audience.

s0218.literal: The Jiang-Huai region and the circuits of Zhejiang east and west and Hu-nan north and south yielded thirty-seven prefectures, one hundred twenty-eight zhou, one guan, one jian, and seven hundred thirty-three counties, with nine million three hundred seventy thousand four hundred seventy-two households and nineteen million seven hundred twenty thousand one thousand fifteen persons.
s0218.idiomatic: The Jiang-Huai region and the circuits of Zhejiang east and west and Hu-nan north and south yielded thirty-seven prefectures, one hundred twenty-eight zhou, one guan, one jian, and seven hundred thirty-three counties, with nine million three hundred seventy thousand four hundred seventy-two households and nineteen million seven hundred twenty thousand one thousand fifteen persons.

s0219.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on jiazi day Chen Yan was granted fifty taels of gold for capturing Xincheng and Dingcun; his subordinate Liu Zhong and others received silver in graded amounts.
s0219.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on jiazi day Chen Yan was granted fifty taels of gold for capturing Xincheng and Dingcun; his subordinate Liu Zhong and others received graded gifts of silver.

s0220.literal: On yihai day the Prince of Beiping's expedition soldiers who were poor were granted sheep, horses, and cloth in graded amounts.
s0220.idiomatic: On yihai day expedition soldiers of the Prince of Beiping who were poor received graded gifts of sheep, horses, and cloth.

s0221.literal: The prohibition on forcing free persons into prostitution was clarified.
s0221.idiomatic: The prohibition on forcing free persons into prostitution was reaffirmed.

s0222.literal: On dinghai day Liang-Zhe pacification commissioner Jiao Youzhi presented the classics, paintings, and yin-yang and secretarial books from Lin'an.
s0222.idiomatic: On dinghai day Liang-Zhe pacification commissioner Jiao Youzhi presented the classics, paintings, and yin-yang and secretarial books from Lin'an.

s0223.literal: On wuzi day Huai-xi pacification commissioner Xia Gui requested to come to court and asked that his grandson Yisun be permitted to act as pacification commissioner in his stead; this was granted.
s0223.idiomatic: On wuzi day Huai-xi pacification commissioner Xia Gui asked to come to court and requested that his grandson Yisun act as pacification commissioner in his stead; the request was granted.

s0224.literal: Ariq was made grand councillor; Qara Qasun, pacification commissioner of Henan and other circuits, was made right vice grand councillor; Minister of War Wang Yi, Minister of Personnel and concurrent Lin'an prefect Yang Zhen, and Henan-Hebei circuit investigating censor Mirhosen were all made associate administrators.
s0224.idiomatic: Ariq was made grand councillor; Qara Qasun, pacification commissioner of Henan and other circuits, was made right vice grand councillor; minister of war Wang Yi, minister of personnel and concurrent Lin'an prefect Yang Zhen, and Henan-Hebei circuit investigating censor Mirhosen were all made associate administrators.

s0225.literal: Associate Administrator Chen Yan conducted branch secretariat affairs at Huai-east.
s0225.idiomatic: Associate administrator Chen Yan conducted branch secretariat affairs at Huai-east.

s0226.literal: In the eleventh month, on guisi day, the army of the Prince of Anxi took Wan Prefecture.
s0226.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guisi day, the army of the Prince of Anxi took Wan Prefecture.

s0227.literal: On bingwu day two hundred thirty-nine meritorious officers of Aju's command were each granted two hundred fifty taels of silver.
s0227.idiomatic: On bingwu day two hundred thirty-nine meritorious officers of Aju's command each received two hundred fifty taels of silver.

s0228.literal: The Sichuan branch commission Hudun said: "My troops have long besieged Chongqing and many have deserted; I ask for ten thousand additional troops and also an edict to summon back fugitive people at Daliangping."
s0228.idiomatic: The Sichuan branch commission Hudun said, "My troops have long besieged Chongqing and many have deserted; I ask for ten thousand additional troops and an edict to summon back fugitive people at Daliangping."

s0230.literal: On renzi day meritorious soldiers of the Longdawen army and those who died in service were granted silver notes in graded amounts.
s0230.idiomatic: On renzi day meritorious soldiers of the Longdawen army and those who died in service received graded gifts of silver notes.

s0231.literal: On guichou day internal and external offices were consolidated.
s0231.idiomatic: On guichou day internal and external offices were consolidated.

s0232.literal: On dingmao day the moon transited Saturn.
s0232.idiomatic: On dingmao day the moon transited Saturn.

s0233.literal: On gengshen day an edict ordered that officials who governed the people and managed finances be appointed through the Central Secretariat, and military officers be assigned through the Privy Council.
s0233.idiomatic: On gengshen day an edict ordered that officials governing the people and managing finances be appointed through the Central Secretariat, and military officers assigned through the Privy Council.

s0234.literal: The fortifications of Xianghan, Jinghu, and other places were demolished.
s0234.idiomatic: The fortifications of Xianghan, Jinghu, and other places were demolished.

s0235.literal: Southern Pacification Commissioner and concurrent Kuizhou prefect Zhao Zhen requested an edict to summon Kuizhou pacification commissioner Zhang Qiyan; this was granted.
s0235.idiomatic: Southern pacification commissioner and concurrent Kuizhou prefect Zhao Zhen asked for an edict to summon Kuizhou pacification commissioner Zhang Qiyan; the request was granted.

s0236.literal: King Wang Chŏm of Goryeo sent his chief secretary of the Palace Secretariat Zhu Yue to report that he had changed his name to Chun.
s0236.idiomatic: King Wang Chŏm of Goryeo sent his chief secretary of the Palace Secretariat Zhu Yue to report that he had changed his name to Chun.

s0237.literal: In the twelfth month, on the xinyou new moon, Mars occulted Hook and Curdle.
s0237.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the xinyou new moon, Mars occulted Hook and Curdle.

s0238.literal: The calendar for the fourteenth year was granted to Goryeo.
s0238.idiomatic: The calendar for the fourteenth year was granted to Goryeo.

s0239.literal: On dingmao day Yunnan's Luopu district was made Yuanjiang Prefecture Circuit.
s0239.idiomatic: On dingmao day Yunnan's Luopu district was made Yuanjiang Prefecture Circuit.

s0240.literal: On xinwei day warriors of Tachai's command and those who died in service were granted silver notes in graded amounts.
s0240.idiomatic: On xinwei day warriors of Tachai's command and those who died in service received graded gifts of silver notes.

s0241.literal: Nineteen soldiers meritorious in battle under Qubilai and others were granted one thousand two hundred taels of silver.
s0241.idiomatic: Nineteen soldiers meritorious in battle under Qubilai and others received one thousand two hundred taels of silver.

s0242.literal: On renshen day Li Sijing reported that transport commissioner Jiang Yi's statements were reckless and false, citing Yi's wife and children as witnesses.
s0242.idiomatic: On renshen day Li Sijing reported that transport commissioner Jiang Yi's statements were reckless and false, citing Yi's wife and children as witnesses.

s0243.literal: The Emperor said: "Can wives and children serve as witnesses?"
s0243.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Can wives and children serve as witnesses?"

s0244.literal: An edict ordered that the matter not be pursued.
s0244.idiomatic: An edict ordered that the matter not be pursued.

s0245.literal: On yihai day the offices established in Jiangnan were fixed.
s0245.idiomatic: On yihai day the offices established in Jiangnan were fixed.

s0246.literal: On xinsi day, because the garrison troops besieging Chongqing had suffered hardship, six thousand ingots of notes were granted.
s0246.idiomatic: On xinsi day, because the garrison troops besieging Chongqing had suffered hardship, six thousand ingots of notes were granted.

s0247.literal: On gengyin day an edict instructed the officials, soldiers, and people of prefectures, zhou, armies, and counties in Zhejiang east and west, Jiang east and west, Huai east and west, and Hu-nan north: "Formerly wanhu and qianhu plundered the people and caused them to flee; now all people are to be returned to their original registers in zhou and counties.
s0247.idiomatic: On gengyin day an edict instructed the officials, soldiers, and people of prefectures, zhou, armies, and counties in Zhejiang east and west, Jiang east and west, Huai east and west, and Hu-nan north: "Formerly wanhu and qianhu plundered the people and caused them to flee; now all people are to be returned to their original registers in zhou and counties.

s0248.literal: Any military commanders and Song officials who by force seized the people's fields, houses, and property shall have each restored to its owner; where there is no owner, it shall be given to nearby people without means of livelihood.
s0248.idiomatic: Any military commanders and Song officials who by force seized the people's fields, houses, and property shall have each restored to its owner; where there is no owner, it shall be given to nearby people without means of livelihood.

s0249.literal: Field rents, commercial taxes, tea, salt, wine, vinegar, gold, silver, iron smelting, bamboo goods, and lake dues shall all be collected according to actual amounts.
s0249.idiomatic: Field rents, commercial taxes, tea, salt, wine, vinegar, gold, silver, iron smelting, bamboo goods, and lake dues shall all be collected according to actual amounts.

s0250.literal: All more than one hundred items of former Song redundant levies, imperial birthday tributes, and consolidated emergency funds are entirely abolished."
s0250.idiomatic: All more than one hundred items of former Song redundant levies, imperial birthday tributes, and consolidated emergency funds are entirely abolished."

s0251.literal: Bayan said: "Zhang Hui guarded the Song treasury and, without awaiting orders, opened the keys on his own authority."
s0251.idiomatic: Bayan said, "Zhang Hui guarded the Song treasury and, without awaiting orders, opened the keys on his own authority."

s0252.literal: An edict ordered Aju to investigate the matter and also instructed officials east and west of the Jiang and east and west of Zhe and Huai to audit old and new revenues and grain.
s0252.idiomatic: An edict ordered Aju to investigate the matter and also instructed officials east and west of the Jiang and east and west of Zhe and Huai to audit old and new revenues and grain.

s0253.literal: Pacification commissioners of the five circuits of western Zhejiang, eastern Zhejiang, Jiangxi, eastern Jiang, and Hubei were abolished.
s0253.idiomatic: Pacification commissioners of the five circuits of western Zhejiang, eastern Zhejiang, Jiangxi, eastern Jiang, and Hubei were abolished.

s0254.literal: Jiangling was promoted to a superior route; Ruian Prefecture remained Wen Prefecture; Long Prefecture became a scattered prefecture; Fengrun County was restored in Ji Prefecture; and Lintao Weiyuan Fort was promoted to a county.
s0254.idiomatic: Jiangling was promoted to a superior route; Ruian Prefecture remained Wen Prefecture; Long Prefecture became a scattered prefecture; Fengrun County was restored in Ji Prefecture; and Lintao Weiyuan Fort was promoted to a county.

s0255.literal: The princes were granted gold, silver, cloth, and silk according to the annual precedent.
s0255.idiomatic: The princes received gold, silver, cloth, and silk according to the annual precedent.

s0256.literal: Prince Naimantai and others were granted the price of sheep and horses.
s0256.idiomatic: Prince Naimantai and others received payment for sheep and horses.

s0257.literal: Aju and others were rewarded for battle merit; surrendered ministers Wu Jian, Xia Gui, and others were granted silver, notes, cloth, and silk in graded amounts; Bayan, Aju, and others received blue-squirrel, silver-squirrel, and yellow-weasel zisun garments; the remaining meritorious officials received leopard and roe-deer furs and fur hats and robes in graded amounts.
s0257.idiomatic: Aju and others were rewarded for battle merit; surrendered ministers Wu Jian, Xia Gui, and others received graded gifts of silver, notes, cloth, and silk; Bayan, Aju, and others received blue-squirrel, silver-squirrel, and yellow-weasel zisun garments; the remaining meritorious officials received graded gifts of leopard and roe-deer furs and fur hats and robes.

s0258.literal: That year, because Dongping, Jinan, Tai'an, Dezhou, Lianhai, Qinghe, Pingluan, and the three zhou west of the Western Capital lacked food from flood and drought, garrison troops, civilians, and relay households were relieved with two hundred twenty-five thousand five hundred sixty shi of rice, forty-seven thousand seven hundred twelve shi of grain, and four thousand two hundred eighty-two ingots and a fraction of notes.
s0258.idiomatic: That year, because Dongping, Jinan, Tai'an, Dezhou, Lianhai, Qinghe, Pingluan, and the three zhou west of the Western Capital lacked food from flood and drought, garrison troops, civilians, and relay households were relieved with two hundred twenty-five thousand five hundred sixty shi of rice, forty-seven thousand seven hundred twelve shi of grain, and four thousand two hundred eighty-two ingots and a fraction of notes.

s0259.literal: Pingyang Circuit suffered drought; Jining Circuit and Goryeo's Shen Prefecture suffered flood; this year's field rents were all remitted.
s0259.idiomatic: Pingyang Circuit suffered drought; Jining Circuit and Goryeo's Shen Prefecture suffered flood; this year's field rents were all remitted.

s0260.literal: Thirty-four persons were executed for capital crimes.
s0260.idiomatic: Thirty-four persons were executed for capital crimes.

s0261.literal: In the fourteenth year, spring, first month, on guisi day, the mobile headquarters army halted in Guangdong; Liu Xing, prefect of Xun Prefecture, surrendered the city.
s0261.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, on guisi day of the first month of spring, the mobile headquarters army halted in Guangdong; Liu Xing, prefect of Xun Prefecture, surrendered the city.

s0262.literal: On bingshen day, because Jiangnan had been pacified and the people were exhausted supplying the army, this year's silk and silver levies on all circuits were remitted.
s0262.idiomatic: On bingshen day, because Jiangnan had been pacified and the people were exhausted supplying the army, this year's silk and silver levies on all circuits were remitted.

s0263.literal: Zhang Zongyan, Celestial Master of the Succession Han, was granted the title Perfect Man of Spirit Response and Harmonious Balance and put in charge of Daoism in all Jiangnan circuits.
s0263.idiomatic: Zhang Zongyan, Celestial Master of the Succession Han, was granted the title Perfect Man of Spirit Response and Harmonious Balance and put in charge of Daoism in all Jiangnan circuits.

s0264.literal: On wuxu day Kim Panggyŏng and others of Goryeo raised disturbance; the Goryeo king was ordered to punish them, and Xindu and Hong Chachiu were ordered to ready troops in defense.
s0264.idiomatic: On wuxu day Kim Panggyŏng and others of Goryeo raised disturbance; the Goryeo king was ordered to punish them, and Xindu and Hong Chachiu were ordered to ready troops in defense.

s0265.literal: On guimao day the circuit investigating censorates were restored.
s0265.idiomatic: On guimao day the circuit investigating censorates were restored.

s0266.literal: On jiachen day Aju was ordered to select ten thousand elite troops to come to court.
s0266.idiomatic: On jiachen day Aju was ordered to select ten thousand elite troops to come to court.

s0267.literal: On dingwei day Qian Rongzhi, prefect of Mei Prefecture, surrendered the city.
s0267.idiomatic: On dingwei day Qian Rongzhi, prefect of Mei Prefecture, surrendered the city.

s0268.literal: On wushen day eight thousand three hundred fifty-two poor soldiers of the three guards were each granted two ingots of notes and ten bolts of cloth.
s0268.idiomatic: On wushen day eight thousand three hundred fifty-two poor soldiers of the three guards each received two ingots of notes and ten bolts of cloth.

s0269.literal: On jiyou day Yelü Zhuo was granted one thousand ingots of notes.
s0269.idiomatic: On jiyou day Yelü Zhuo received one thousand ingots of notes.

s0270.literal: On jiayin day an edict ordered that the property of Song Prince of Fu Zhao Yurui at Hang and Yue be transported to the capital by the responsible offices and delivered to his family.
s0270.idiomatic: On jiayin day an edict ordered that the property of Song Prince of Fu Zhao Yurui at Hang and Yue be transported to the capital by the responsible offices and delivered to his family.

s0271.literal: On bingchen day the four circuits of Jiandu and Luolosi were established, garrisons were placed at Wumu and other places, and officials were appointed.
s0271.idiomatic: On bingchen day the four circuits of Jiandu and Luolosi were established, garrisons were placed at Wumu and other places, and officials were appointed.

s0272.literal: On jiwei day six cups of white jade, green jade, and crystal were presented to the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0272.idiomatic: On jiwei day six cups of white jade, green jade, and crystal were presented to the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0273.literal: Two thousand hunter households of the Shangdu, Longxing, Northern Capital, and Western Capital routes were conscripted as troops.
s0273.idiomatic: Two thousand hunter households of the Shangdu, Longxing, Northern Capital, and Western Capital routes were conscripted as troops.

s0274.literal: The Jiang-Huai and other circuits salt transport commission and the Jiang-Huai tea monopoly transport commission were established.
s0274.idiomatic: The Jiang-Huai and other circuits salt transport commission and the Jiang-Huai tea monopoly transport commission were established.

s0275.literal: Zhang Zongyan, Celestial Master of the Succession Han, was ordered to perform the Grand Heaven Offering at the Changchun Palace; when Zongyan returned to Jiangnan, his disciple Zhang Liusun remained at the capital.
s0275.idiomatic: Zhang Zongyan, Celestial Master of the Succession Han, was ordered to perform the Grand Heaven Offering at the Changchun Palace; when Zongyan returned to Jiangnan, his disciple Zhang Liusun remained at the capital.

s0276.literal: In the second month, on xinyou day, Eastern Campaign marshal Hong Chachiu was ordered to lead two thousand troops to Shangdu.
s0276.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinyou day, Eastern Campaign marshal Hong Chachiu was ordered to lead two thousand troops to Shangdu.

s0277.literal: On renxu day Ruizhou pacification commissioner Yao Wenlong led Zhang Wenxian to surrender; his family had been killed by Song people, and Wenlong, Wenxian, and others were granted notes in graded amounts.
s0277.idiomatic: On renxu day Ruizhou pacification commissioner Yao Wenlong led Zhang Wenxian to surrender; his family had been killed by Song people, and Wenlong, Wenxian, and others received graded gifts of notes.

s0278.literal: On guihai day a comet appeared in the northeast, more than four chi long.
s0278.idiomatic: On guihai day a comet appeared in the northeast, more than four chi long.

s0279.literal: On jiazi day envoys were dispatched to perform sacrifice at the mountains, rivers, and earth altar in the Emperor's stead.
s0279.idiomatic: On jiazi day envoys were dispatched to perform sacrifice at the mountains, rivers, and earth altar in the Emperor's stead.

s0280.literal: On bingyin day the bronze seal of the Prince of Anxi's tutor was changed to a silver seal.
s0280.idiomatic: On bingyin day the bronze seal of the Prince of Anxi's tutor was changed to a silver seal.

s0281.literal: Relay stations at Shandan city and elsewhere in Yongchang Circuit were established, and one thousand ingots of notes were granted as capital to draw interest for relay expenses.
s0281.idiomatic: Relay stations at Shandan city and elsewhere in Yongchang Circuit were established, and one thousand ingots of notes were granted as capital to draw interest for relay expenses.

s0282.literal: Prince Zhibi Temür said: "One hundred twenty relay households of Yongchang Circuit are exhausted supplying the service and have pawned wives and children to meet corvée duty."
s0282.idiomatic: Prince Zhibi Temür said, "One hundred twenty relay households of Yongchang Circuit are exhausted supplying the service and have pawned wives and children to meet corvée duty."

s0283.literal: An edict granted one hundred eighty ingots of notes to redeem them.
s0283.idiomatic: An edict granted one hundred eighty ingots of notes to redeem them.

s0284.literal: On dingmao day Jinghu north circuit pacification commissioner Tachai recovered forty-seven mountain stockades of Guizhou.
s0284.idiomatic: On dingmao day Jinghu north circuit pacification commissioner Tachai recovered forty-seven mountain stockades of Guizhou.

s0285.literal: On wuchen day the Former Farmer was sacrificed at the eastern suburb.
s0285.idiomatic: On wuchen day the Former Farmer was sacrificed at the eastern suburb.

s0286.literal: On jiaxu day Buqa of the Sichuan branch commission led tens of thousands of troops to Chongqing, encamped at Fotuguan, built scaling ladders and rams to attack it, and that night commander-in-chief Zhao An surrendered the city.
s0286.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Buqa of the Sichuan branch commission led tens of thousands of troops to Chongqing, encamped at Fotuguan, built scaling ladders and rams to attack it, and that night commander-in-chief Zhao An surrendered the city.

s0287.literal: Zhang Jue moored his boats mid-river and fled downstream with his wives and concubines toward Fu Prefecture; marshal Zhang Derun intercepted him with a fleet, and Jue then surrendered.
s0287.idiomatic: Zhang Jue moored his boats mid-river and fled downstream with his wives and concubines toward Fu Prefecture; marshal Zhang Derun intercepted him with a fleet, and Jue then surrendered.

s0288.literal: The imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.
s0288.idiomatic: The imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.

s0289.literal: On xinsi day the Northern Capital was ordered to select three hundred troops under Fuzhu's command to proceed to Shangdu.
s0289.idiomatic: On xinsi day the Northern Capital was ordered to select three hundred troops under Fuzhu's command to proceed to Shangdu.

s0290.literal: On renwu day the fortifications of Ji and Fu prefectures were demolished; Longxing, on the west bank of the Jiang, was temporarily kept.
s0290.idiomatic: On renwu day the fortifications of Ji and Fu prefectures were demolished; Longxing, on the west bank of the Jiang, was temporarily kept.

s0291.literal: Ting Prefecture cavalry were also selected to garrison Ruijin County.
s0291.idiomatic: Ting Prefecture cavalry were also selected to garrison Ruijin County.

s0292.literal: On bingxu day Lian Prefecture defender Guo Yuanlong, who had already surrendered, rebelled again; Tachai led troops to punish him, and Yuanlong abandoned the city and fled.
s0292.idiomatic: On bingxu day Lian Prefecture defender Guo Yuanlong, who had already surrendered, rebelled again; Tachai led troops to punish him, and Yuanlong abandoned the city and fled.

s0293.literal: On dinghai day Nan'en Prefecture prefect Chen Yaodao and vice commissioner Lin Shuhu surrendered the city.
s0293.idiomatic: On dinghai day Nan'en Prefecture prefect Chen Yaodao and vice commissioner Lin Shuhu surrendered the city.

s0294.literal: An edict made the monks Kangji Yi and Yilian Jiajiawa general supervisors of Jiangnan, in charge of the Buddhist clergy, remitting monastic rents and taxes and forbidding disturbance of monasteries.
s0294.idiomatic: An edict made the monks Kangji Yi and Yilian Jiajiawa general supervisors of Jiangnan, in charge of the Buddhist clergy, remitting monastic rents and taxes and forbidding disturbance of monasteries.

s0295.literal: Boluo, grand minister of agriculture, censor-in-chief, and pacification commissioner who also conducted ceremonial affairs, was made vice marshal of the Privy Council, concurrently director of palace provisions, and put in charge of ceremonial affairs.
s0295.idiomatic: Boluo, grand minister of agriculture, censor-in-chief, and pacification commissioner who also conducted ceremonial affairs, was made vice marshal of the Privy Council, concurrently director of palace provisions, and put in charge of ceremonial affairs.

s0296.literal: In the third month, on the gengyin new moon, because there had been no rain or snow in winter and spring moisture had not followed, envoys were sent to the Hanlin Academy and History Office to inquire about measures benefiting the people; Yelü Zhuo, Yao Shu, Wang Pan, Dou Mo, and others replied: "The way to sufficient food is only to cut wasteful expenditure; nothing consumes more grain than brewing liquor and malt.
s0296.idiomatic: In the third month, on the gengyin new moon, because there had been no rain or snow in winter and spring moisture had not followed, envoys were sent to the Hanlin Academy and History Office to inquire about measures benefiting the people; Yelü Zhuo, Yao Shu, Wang Pan, Dou Mo, and others replied, "The way to sufficient food is only to cut wasteful expenditure; nothing consumes more grain than brewing liquor and malt.

s0297.literal: Moreover, since Zhou and Han times there have been clear prohibitions.
s0297.idiomatic: Moreover, since Zhou and Han times there have been clear prohibitions.

s0298.literal: Prayer offerings to shrines and spirits also cost no little; all should be forbidden."
s0298.idiomatic: Prayer offerings to shrines and spirits also cost no little; all should be forbidden."

s0300.literal: On xinmao day the Hu-Guang branch secretariat said: "All twenty-four prefectures of Guangxi have already submitted; it is proposed to restore the branch secretariat at Tan Prefecture and establish the Guangnan west circuit pacification commission at Jingjiang."
s0300.idiomatic: On xinmao day the Hu-Guang branch secretariat said, "All twenty-four prefectures of Guangxi have already submitted; it is proposed to restore the branch secretariat at Tan Prefecture and establish the Guangnan west circuit pacification commission at Jingjiang."
